build_tags_bypass.label: Spoof Build.TAGS
build_tags_bypass.description: Forces Build.TAGS to return 'release-keys' instead of 'test-keys'
build_tags_bypass.smali_replacement:
# Build.TAGS patched by APK Security Studio
    const-string {reg}, "release-keys"

build_fingerprint_bypass.label: Spoof Build.FINGERPRINT
build_fingerprint_bypass.description: Forces Build.FINGERPRINT to not contain 'generic' or 'unknown'

su_binary_check_bypass.label: Bypass su Binary Checks
su_binary_check_bypass.description: Makes File.exists() return false for su paths

rootbeer_bypass.label: Bypass RootBeer Library
rootbeer_bypass.description: Hooks all RootBeer detection methods to return false

native_root_bypass.label: Bypass Native Root Checks (JNI)
native_root_bypass.description: Patches JNI native root detection methods

license_check_true.label: Force License Valid
license_check_true.description: Patches license check methods to always return true/licensed

signature_verify_bypass.label: Bypass Signature Verification
signature_verify_bypass.description: Hooks PackageManager.getPackageSignatures to return expected signature

base64_pubkey_nullify.label: Nullify License Public Key
base64_pubkey_nullify.description: Replaces Base64 encoded license public keys with zeros

ad_removal.label: Remove Advertisements
ad_removal.description: NOPs out ad initialization and display methods

build_model_bypass.label: Spoof Build.MODEL
build_model_bypass.description: Forces Build.MODEL to return a real device model

build_product_bypass.label: Spoof Build.PRODUCT
build_product_bypass.description: Forces Build.PRODUCT to not contain 'emulator' or 'sdk'

telephony_imei_bypass.label: Spoof Device IMEI
telephony_imei_bypass.description: Returns a realistic IMEI instead of zeros/nulls

ssl_pinning_universal.label: Universal SSL Pinning Bypass
ssl_pinning_universal.description: Bypasses OkHttp, Conscrypt, TrustManager SSL certificate pinning
